title: Pre-dynastic Maadi lion cult around the Sphinx
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Pre-dynastic Maadi lion cult around the Sphinx, about 5000-7000 BC at Giza, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, you have the Mi culture that lived in the area of Giza. And I've always thought that it it was perfectly possible that the Sphinx could have been their god

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that an early people known as the Maadi culture lived around Giza in Egypt before the first kings, perhaps 5,000 to 7,000 years before Christ. Drawing on the work of Robert Schoch, he says he has always thought the Sphinx, the giant lion-bodied statue at Giza, could have been their god. If true, the Sphinx would be far older than the pharaohs.
